title: Module 2 Quiz: Saving Like a Superhero

questions.text: What does drawing your savings goal and putting it on the wall help you do?
options: Remember to save your pocket money
questions.explanation: The picture reminds you to save, as shown in Lesson 1.

questions.text: According to the Golden Hero Rule, which habit builds the most savings power?
options: Saving a big amount once a year
Saving a small coin every week
Saving only when you feel like it
questions.explanation: Saving a little regularly beats saving a lot once, as the rule states.

questions.text: If you skip a one‑coin treat today, how many more coins do you need for a ten‑coin cape?
questions.explanation: Skipping the treat saves the coin, leaving you needing five more coins for the cape.

questions.text: Saving a large amount once is better than saving a little each time.
questions.explanation: The Golden Hero Rule says small, regular savings beat a big amount saved once.
